    The path algebra is spanned by vertices and paths #

    Words of non-composable lists vanish (word_eq_zero_of_not_path), words multiply by concatenation (word_append), and so the vertex idempotents together with the words of nonempty paths span the path algebra (span_vertex_path).

    theorem LargeIndecomposable.FinQuiver.word_append (k : Type u) [Field k] {Q : FinQuiver} (l l' : List Q.A) :
    word k Q (l ++ l') = word k Q l' * word k Q l
